description: Frontend for all Batch 1 features, consuming the FEAT-001 API. Adds a self-contained Code128-B SVG barcode generator (src/barcode.js), SKU input/column + inline barcode + per-product movement history in the product modal, an Archive view with restore and admin permanent-delete, an admin Stock log view, CSV bulk import with a validated preview plus SKU-extended export, and an in-app low-stock notification bell. Depends on FEAT-001; implement after it. All changes live in src/App.jsx, src/App.css, and the new src/barcode.js, matching the existing terse single-file style and reusing existing CSS classes.
steps: Create src/barcode.js exporting `code128BarcodeSvg(value, { height = 48, moduleWidth = 2 } = {})` that returns an SVG string. Implement Code128-B: Start-B code 104, encode each ASCII char as (charCode - 32), checksum = (104 + sum(i * value_i)) mod 103, Stop code 106 (with its trailing 2-bar). Use the standard 108-entry pattern table (each entry a 6-digit bar/space width string). Emit <rect> elements for black modules on a white background and compute total width. Keep it dependency-free and minimal but correct. (If you add a tiny React wrapper component, keep hook rules clean for oxlint react/rules-of-hooks.)

In src/App.jsx add `sku: ''` to `blankForm`. In the product modal form add an optional SKU <input> with placeholder 'auto-generate if empty' bound to form.sku. In openEditModal keep sku from the product. Pass sku through handleSubmit's product payload (empty string lets the server auto-generate).
Add a SKU column to the products <table> (header + cell showing product.sku). In the EDIT product modal, render the Code128 barcode inline as SVG from code128BarcodeSvg(form.sku) once a sku exists.

In the edit modal, when editingId is set, fetch `GET ${API_URL}/products/${editingId}/movements` with authHeaders() and render a history list/table: delta shown with +/- and color (reuse .status / add a small .delta-up/.delta-down class), stock_before -> stock_after, user_name, reason, and formatted created_at. Handle the empty/offline case gracefully.

Add an 'Archive' nav item in the sidebar Inventory group. Add an archive view: on open, fetch `GET ${API_URL}/products/archived`; render a table of archived products with a Restore button (`POST ${API_URL}/products/${id}/restore`) and, for admins only (isAdmin), a permanent-delete button (`DELETE ${API_URL}/products/${id}/permanent`) behind the existing confirm-modal pattern. After restore/permanent-delete, refresh both the archive list and the products list and pushToast the result.

Keep the existing product delete confirm modal UX but update its copy to reflect that delete now archives (recoverable) rather than being permanent. The DELETE call is unchanged (server now soft-deletes); after it, remove the row from the products list as today.

Add a 'Stock log' nav item under the Administration group (render only when isAdmin, like Users). Add an admin stock-log view: fetch `GET ${API_URL}/stock-movements`; render a .catalog-panel table (product name, delta with +/- color, before -> after, user, reason, timestamp), newest-first. Reuse .table-wrap / .status classes.
Extend `exportCsv`: header becomes ['Name','Category','Price','Stock','Status','SKU'] and each row appends product.sku (empty string when null) so export/import round-trip.

Add an 'Import' button next to the Export button in the products panel heading/toolbar. On file select (<input type=file accept='.csv'>), read and parse the CSV client-side: split lines, parse the header, map columns Name/Category/Price/Stock/Status/SKU (tolerate missing SKU and Status; handle quoted values matching exportCsv's escaping). Build parsed rows.

Show an import preview modal (reuse .modal / .table-wrap): list parsed rows with validation flags — invalid/non-numeric price or stock, and duplicate SKUs within the file. Disable confirm when any row is invalid (or clearly mark invalid rows). On confirm, `POST ${API_URL}/products/bulk` with { products: validRows }; on success refresh the products list and pushToast created count; on failure show the server message. Close the modal.

Add `const LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD = 5` (module scope near other consts). Derive from the loaded products list: lowOrOut = products where stock === 0 OR (stock > 0 && stock <= LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD) OR status === 'Low stock'. Add a bell icon (lucide-react Bell) in the top bar with a count badge of that length (hide badge when 0). Clicking toggles a dropdown/panel listing those products (name, stock, status) with an 'Edit' action that opens the product edit modal for that product. Purely client-side; no fetch; no email.

Add minimal new CSS in src/App.css for the barcode container, the notification bell + badge + dropdown, the delta up/down coloring, and the import preview invalid-row marker — matching the existing variable/spacing/color style. Reuse existing classes everywhere else.
acceptance_criteria: src/barcode.js exists and code128BarcodeSvg returns a valid <svg> string with Start-B, a mod-103 checksum, and Stop; it is used to render a barcode from a product SKU in the UI with no new npm dependency.

The product form has an optional SKU input ('auto-generate if empty'), the product table shows a SKU column, and the edit modal shows the barcode plus that product's stock-movement history (delta +/- colored, before->after, user, reason, time).
An Archive view lists soft-deleted products with Restore for all users and permanent-delete for admins only; the normal product delete now archives (recoverable) and its confirm copy reflects that.
An admin-only Stock log view lists recent movements across products (product, delta colored, before->after, user, reason, timestamp), newest-first.

exportCsv output includes a SKU column; the Import button parses a CSV client-side, shows a validation preview (flags bad price/stock and duplicate SKUs) before committing, and on confirm posts to /api/products/bulk and refreshes the list.

A top-bar bell shows a badge count of low/out-of-stock products and opens a panel listing them with a quick edit link; it is derived purely from the loaded products list with no backend call and no email.
App still builds and lints clean.

findings:
Frontend implemented across src/barcode.js (new), src/App.jsx, and src/App.css.

src/barcode.js: exports code128BarcodeSvg(value, { height = 48, moduleWidth = 2 } = {}) returning an SVG string. Hand-written Code128-B (108-entry pattern table, Start-B=104, mod-103 checksum, Stop=106 with its 7-module trailing bar). Black <rect> modules on a white background, width computed from module widths. No new npm dependency. Non-ASCII/out-of-range chars (outside 32..126) are skipped so output stays valid.

src/App.jsx changes:
- blankForm gains `sku: ''`; module-scope `const LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD = 5`.
- Product form: optional SKU <input> ('auto-generate if empty') bound to form.sku; openEditModal keeps product.sku; handleSubmit already forwards sku via the {...form} payload (empty string -> server auto-generates).
- Products table: added a SKU column (header + cell showing product.sku or '—'); empty-state colSpan bumped 6->7.
- Edit modal: renders the Code128 barcode inline (dangerouslySetInnerHTML from code128BarcodeSvg(form.sku)) when editing and a sku exists; fetches GET /products/:id/movements on open and renders a history table (delta +/- colored via .delta-up/.delta-down, before->after, user, reason, localized time). Handles empty/offline gracefully (movements default to []).
- Archive view: new 'Archive' nav item under Inventory; view fetches GET /products/archived, lists archived products with Restore (POST /products/:id/restore) for all users and permanent-delete (DELETE /products/:id/permanent) for admins only behind the confirm-modal pattern. Restore refreshes archive+products and toasts.
- Delete confirm copy now says the product is archived (recoverable); the DELETE call is unchanged (server soft-deletes) and the row is removed from the list as before; success toast updated to 'Produk diarsipkan.'.
- Stock log view: new admin-only 'Stock log' nav item under Administration; fetches GET /stock-movements and renders a .catalog-panel table (product name, delta colored, before->after, user, reason, localized timestamp), newest-first from the server.
- exportCsv header is now ['Name','Category','Price','Stock','Status','SKU'] and each row appends product.sku ('' when null) for round-trip.
- Import: 'Import' button (file input, accept='.csv') next to Export. CSV is parsed client-side (quoted-value aware, tolerates missing SKU/Status, maps columns by header name case-insensitively). An import preview modal lists parsed rows with validation (missing name, non-numeric/negative price or stock, duplicate SKU within file); confirm is disabled when no row is valid, invalid rows marked. On confirm, POST /products/bulk with { products: validRows }, refresh products, toast created count; server error message surfaced.
- Low-stock bell: derived lowOrOut (stock===0 OR 0<stock<=LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD OR status==='Low stock') via useMemo; Bell icon in products top bar with a count badge (hidden when 0); clicking toggles a dropdown listing those products (name, stock, status) with an Edit action opening the product edit modal. Purely client-side, no fetch, no email.

src/App.css: added minimal classes matching existing style — .topbar-actions/.panel-heading-actions/.import-button, notification bell (.notif-wrap/.notif-bell/.notif-badge/.notif-panel/.notif-list/.notif-edit), .delta-up/.delta-down, .barcode-box, .movement-history, and import preview (.import-modal/.row-invalid/.import-error). Everything else reuses existing classes.

VERIFICATION: `npm.cmd run build` (vite build) succeeded (exit 0, ~1886 modules). `npm.cmd run lint` (oxlint) exit 0 with no errors; only the 3 pre-existing set-state-in-effect warnings and the 2 pre-existing purity warnings in the unchanged pushToast remain — no new errors or warnings from this work (react/rules-of-hooks and react/only-export-components clean).
